Marta (CS): Heads-up: Vega wants a high-touch demo next Thu with execs. They asked for an "ops quick card" they can run 5 minutes before the call — focusing on caching, batching, streaming and a tiny post-demo pulse for renewal signals. Can SRE/SE help?
Ethan (SRE): I can. Quick check: streaming short-turns or long completions? And expected concurrency?
Marta (CS): Short-turn streaming, ~50 concurrent during the demo, typical user turn ~70 tokens. They run large nightly backfills but can shift an hour.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): For that profile my recommendations: 1) preheat cache for common conversation opens, 2) set streaming.flush_ms=35, 3) batching.target_tokens=6 OR max_wait_ms=25, 4) enable 1% sampling of outputs for hallucination review.
Hannah (PM): Renewal note: they're expansion-ready if demos show stable latency and low error rates. Let's define gating metrics: 99th < 230ms and error rate < 0.5% across the demo window for two demos.
Ethan (SRE): Ops quick card (2-min read) draft:
- Preheat KV cache 6m before demo using the script below.
- Set demo route streaming.flush_ms=35.
- Set batching.target_tokens=6 / max_wait_ms=25.
- Set autoscale spike +30% from -5m to +20m.
- Shift heavy nightly job +1h if possible.
- Capture 1% output samples and Console latency screenshot.

Preheat snippet:
```
# preheat common prefixes
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preheat 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium","prompts":["Hello","Show me recent activity","Where's my invoice?"]}'
```

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Add a short note for expectations: fallback to cpu-quantized model if GPU pool saturated (latency ~1.5-1.8x). Also recommend a quick dry-run with the customer's engineer 24h prior.
Marta (CS): Love it. For the exec pulse form keep it tiny: Q1) Responsiveness 1-5. Q2) Any wrong/confusing answers? Y/N + brief. Ask for Console screenshot.
Ethan (SRE): Health gating process: CS marks account green if gating metrics met for 2 demos within 10 days. Otherwise amber and SE engagement required. We'll also record a renewal risk flag if metrics fail after SE follow-up.
OnboardBot: Reminder: "Vega preheat" scheduled 2026-04-14T14:54:00Z (owner: Marta). :bell:
Marta (CS): Action list: Marta -> share ops quick card + pulse to customer; Ethan -> create infra ticket for autoscale spike & healthcheck; Ravi -> preheat script link + dry-run support; Hannah -> track renewal tile and set gating thresholds. Can everyone confirm?
Ethan (SRE): Confirmed. I'll post ticket link.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Confirmed. I'll do the dry-run with their engineer.
Hannah (PM): Confirmed. I'll update the account health criteria.
Marta (CS): Thanks team. We'll collect feedback after demo and fold notes into the public runbook (ops quick card -> demo survival kit).
